missed_gold.quote: ClearTrail Plus supports the AAC Bluetooth audio codec on compatible phones, so its published Bluetooth version can be treated as evidence for that specific audio-compression capability.
The plastic used in the enclosure of ClearTrail Plus contains at least sixty percent post-consumer recycled material by weight, excluding the electronic components and the external retail packaging.
The Bluetooth connection on CloudNote Air maintains uninterrupted playback at a distance of one hundred metres outdoors, even when a listener changes the phone used as the transmitting device.

claims.quote: For the current India catalogue, ClearTrail Mini is listed at INR 1,200 less than ClearTrail Plus, comparing the two tax-inclusive prices before shipping.
claims.label: contradicted
claims.reason: The price difference between ClearTrail Mini (INR 1,299) and ClearTrail Plus (INR 2,499) is INR 1,200, but the sentence incorrectly states the Mini is listed at INR 1,200 less than the Plus.

claims.quote: For an authorized India purchase with the original invoice and a manufacturing defect, ClearTrail Mini receives a standard manufacturer warranty lasting 18 months from the purchase date.
claims.label: unknown
claims.reason: The catalogue does not specify the duration of the manufacturer warranty for the ClearTrail Mini.

claims.quote: An opened ClearTrail Mini can be returned to any authorized India seller within thirty days for a full refund, even when the speaker has no manufacturing defect or functional problem.
claims.label: unknown
claims.reason: The catalogue does not contain information regarding return policies for opened products.

claims.quote: The sustained amplifier output of ClearTrail Mini is forty watts per channel during ordinary playback, which allows a direct loudness comparison with other speakers advertised using electrical power figures.
claims.label: unknown

claims.label: unknown

claims.quote: The stated laboratory playback time for ClearTrail Mini, using a new battery with EQ off at one hundred percent volume, remains 12 hours without any reduction for louder playback.

claims.reason: The laboratory playback time for ClearTrail Mini at 100% volume is 6 hours, not 12 hours.

claims.quote: For an India purchase at the official catalogue list price on 1 October 2026, ClearTrail Mini costs INR 1,299 including tax but excluding shipping.
claims.label: supported
claims.reason: The price of INR 1,299 for the ClearTrail Mini matches the 2026 catalogue list price.

claims.quote: The official India retail box for ClearTrail Mini includes a wall charging adapter, even though separate accessory lists may make the charging arrangement look less obvious.

claims.quote: The built-in Wi-Fi capability of ClearTrail Mini is absent, which should be treated as a separate specification from its ability to receive audio over Bluetooth.

claims.reason: The catalogue confirms that the ClearTrail Mini does not have built-in Wi-Fi.

claims.quote: A retail purchase of ClearTrail Plus in Germany qualifies for the same 12-month manufacturer warranty described for authorized India purchases, without any different regional terms affecting that duration.
claims.label: unknown
claims.reason: The catalogue does not provide information about warranty terms for Germany.

claims.quote: The manufacturer supports a stereo pair made from one ClearTrail Plus and one ClearTrail Mini, since being members of the same brand is sufficient for cross-model stereo compatibility.
claims.label: contradicted
claims.reason: The catalogue states that stereo pairing is supported only between two units of the same model.

claims.quote: With all port covers closed, the laboratory immersion allowance for ClearTrail Plus is limited to fresh water at no more than one metre for no more than half an hour.
claims.label: supported
claims.reason: The catalogue confirms the immersion limits for ClearTrail Plus.

claims.quote: Considering the speaker alone and leaving retail packaging and accessories out of the measurement, ClearTrail Plus has a stated mass of 0.58 kilograms for carrying-weight comparisons.
claims.label: supported
claims.reason: The catalogue states the weight of ClearTrail Plus is 580 grams, which is 0.58 kilograms.

claims.quote: Basic Bluetooth listening on ClearTrail Plus does not require the manufacturer companion app to be installed, even if a buyer is interested in optional app-related features or settings.
claims.label: supported
claims.reason: The catalogue confirms that basic Bluetooth playback does not require the app.

claims.reason: The catalogue explicitly states that water damage is not covered by the standard manufacturer warranty.

claims.reason: The catalogue confirms stereo pairing is supported only between two units of the same model.
